mission_07: Excellent! You have successfully applied Borderline-SMOTE and compared it with regular SMOTE. You learned how Borderline-SMOTE identifies minority samples near the decision boundary and generates synthetic samples only around these critical instances. This targeted approach is more efficient than SMOTE when classes overlap, as it avoids wasting synthetic samples in regions where the minority class is already well-separated. Use Borderline-SMOTE when your imbalanced dataset has significant class overlap and you want to focus oversampling on the decision boundary region where classification is most challenging.
